title: Phone Ko Dhoop Ka Pata Kaise Chalta Hai? Sach Yeh Hai #shorts
description:
Bahar jaate hi phone ki screen khud tez ho jaati hai, aur camera iska kaaran nahi hai. Chhota light sensor yeh kaam karta hai.
💡 Phone ka ambient light sensor (photodiode) kaise roshni naapta hai
🔬 LDR ke andar CdS track aur electrons ka khel
⚡ LM393 comparator aur blue pot se threshold
🔌 Arduino wiring tip: VCC 5V, AO A0
More maker videos ke liye subscribe karo.
